title: Security found your tablet
scenario: A message says airport security recovered a tablet matching your lost-item report. It includes a photo that looks like yours and asks for a €9 identity-verification fee before the item can be released to the courier.

answers.A: Reply asking for the official case reference, then verify that reference on the airport site yourself.
answers.B: Pay the small fee because the attached photo proves they physically have the device.
answers.C: Use the airport’s official lost-property portal or phone number to check the case and release process.

explanation: Photos and lost-item details can be copied from reports or social posts. The airport’s own case system is the reliable checkpoint.
proTip: A photo proves an image exists; it does not prove who sent it.
